sources.Etsy_market: Alura official MCP, pulled 2026-11-19: search_products (digital, sort est_sales / est_monthly_sales / est_last_month) for japandi, mid century, boho, botanical, coastal, vintage farmhouse, nursery, black and white minimalist, scandinavian, moody vintage, kids room; list_shop_products for SoftNSoft, NorthPrints, LegacyFineArtPrints, FirumWalls, GateOfDesign, LILAxLOLA, ThePosterVenue, NoirPixelStudio, PeekyDigitalArt; get_trending products (rising, digital prints). Sales figures are Alura estimates (est_).
sources.Tony_own: Room_Templates/Portrait_Templates/** renders and previews, including FAILED-checker and Archive items (read only).
sources.Our_Generator: Room_Templates AI_* scene plates made by Portal app/room_slots.scene_prompt (hardcoded "Camera angle: 3/4 corner").

tag_notes.camera_angle: straight | slight_left/right (5-15 deg) | left/right_3q (20-40 deg) | overhead
tag_notes.camera_height: eye | low (knee/hip, typical for floor leans) | counter | seat | high
tag_notes.distance: close (art fills ~45-80% of frame height) | medium | wide (whole room)
tag_notes.kind: room | room_minimal (art + 1-2 objects) | set (several prints) | flat_mock (plain studio wall) | flatlay | bundle_graphic | set_collage
tag_notes.outlier: Etsy rows from rising listings (get_trending or est_last_month sort) or young listings with >=12 est sales per month
